rows.ARS:
Deep yellow Shrub.
Registration name: HORcoffitup
Exhibition name: Celebration 2000
rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin P. Horner (1933-2005) (United Kingdom, 1998).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Paul Chessum Rose Specialist in 1999 as 'Celebration 2000'.
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2004 as 'Rabble Rouser'.
rows.Bloom: Deep yellow, lighter reverse. Mild fragrance. 8 to 14 petals. Average diameter 1.75". Small to medium, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy. Small, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 35" to 39" (90 to 100cm).
